budget: Maximum €80 for TWO for one proper sit-down meal daily; cheaper food for other meals. Prefer a €60–70 order with room for price changes. Menu arithmetic is not a confirmed quote or reservation.
pricing_rules: Published prices and planning allowances are separate below. Water, cover charge, transport and optional alcohol are explicitly identified.
Do not add a bottle of wine automatically. The Verona farm basket already includes two local glasses; the Milan and Varenna baskets do not include alcohol.
Recheck the menu at the door and keep the order below €70–75 if the €80 ceiling is firm. Ask about service charges before ordering.
A meal can be one proper main each plus a shared starter or dessert. There is no need to order every Italian course.
A date in a filename is disclosed. An official menu currently online establishes published prices, not a guarantee that the identical seasonal dishes will be served on the travel date.

proper_meal.name: Risoelatte Duomo
proper_meal.why: A warm 1960s setting and recognisably Milanese dishes, close enough to the cathedral area to avoid a dinner taxi. Better budget fit than ordering two meat mains at Al Mercante.
proper_meal.proposed_time: 19:00; request the earliest table, then head back to the guesthouse and pack for the 06:20 train.
proper_meal.published_hours: Official article: daily 12:00–14:30 and 19:00–23:30. Monday fits; a table is not confirmed.

basket_for_two.status: published menu price; confirm sharing is fine

proper_meal.allowance_status: Planning allowance only: the inspected food page does not publish these charges. Confirm with the restaurant.

cheaper_meal.name: Spontini Duomo
cheaper_meal.why: Milan's thick pizza slice as a quick lunch near the cathedral; save the long meal for dinner.
cheaper_meal.basket: Two Margherita slices and two takeaway waters: published chain-list arithmetic €14.00. Two larger slices with those waters: €19.20.
cheaper_meal.planned_total_eur: €15–22 for two, depending on portion and actual branch pricing
cheaper_meal.qualification: The official chain list warns of outlet variations and excludes the outlet INSIDE Centrale station. Do not transfer these prices to the station outlet. Santa Radegonda is a quick counter/tray-service stop, not a romantic seated dinner.

low_cost_memories.experience: Sant'Ambrogio atrium, interior and accessible crypt: spend time with the Ambrose story rather than paying for another panorama.
low_cost_memories.cost: Main basilica admission is published as free; additional museum spaces or tours are separate.

low_cost_memories.experience: Walk through the Galleria and around Piazza del Duomo after the visit, taking a photo together before dinner.
Keep the Duomo archaeological area for Augustine's baptism connection; make the roof optional to protect money and energy.
low_cost_memories.cost: Choose the official archaeology-inclusive product; do not assume a roof combo includes it.

proper_meal.name: Victoria Grill
proper_meal.address: Piazza San Giorgio, at Hotel Royal Victoria, Varenna
proper_meal.why: A proper meal by the village square with perch risotto and a fully costed menu. This is Victoria Grill, not the hotel's premium Visteria restaurant. Enjoy the lake outside first; the Grill faces the square.
proper_meal.published_hours: Official restaurant page: Thursday–Sunday 12:00–22:00. Thursday fits; confirm 22 October seasonal operation and a table.
proper_meal.menu_status: Prices are in the official site's currently linked Menu_grill_2026_PRIMAVERA.pdf. It is a spring 2026 menu, so reconfirm the autumn dishes.

basket_for_two.status: published menu price; confirm bottle size

proper_meal.optional_cheapest_fallback: The same official menu lists Margherita €10. Two Margheritas + one water €4.50 + two covers €7 total €31.50. This is the stronger price-verified fallback if other inexpensive kitchens are closed.

cheaper_meal.name: ALMA Bistrot
cheaper_meal.why: A simple pizza or focaccia by the waterfront rather than another full-course restaurant meal.
cheaper_meal.hours_status: Exact 22 October opening and kitchen hours were not established from the official page. Ask before relying on it; use the price-verified Victoria Grill pizza fallback if closed.
cheaper_meal.notes: The ALMA website appends numbers such as '1-7 persone' to dishes; these behave like allergen codes, not claims that a €12 pizza feeds seven people. Do not repeat that misleading machine-rendered wording.

low_cost_memories.experience: Walk the Passeggiata degli Innamorati from the ferry landing to the old village, then sit by the water with no appointment to rush toward.
low_cost_memories.cost: Public waterfront walk; no boat ticket required.

low_cost_memories.experience: Keep Villa Monastero if the budget allows: garden-only €13 each versus garden + house €15 each. The extra €4 for two buys a useful indoor fallback.
low_cost_memories.cost: €26 garden-only for two; €30 garden + house for two, full adult prices.

low_cost_memories.experience: Ask the hotel for a quiet waterfront sitting spot and the story of the village's fishing traditions; take your couple photo before dinner while there is still light.
low_cost_memories.cost: No paid experience needed; exact chat with a local is naturally contingent.

dates: 2026-10-24 Saturday lunch only if a later train is chosen

proper_meal.name: Corte San Mattia — Bacaro Agricolo
proper_meal.location: The family farm associated with La Vineria; confirm the room-to-restaurant route with the host.
proper_meal.why: Best fit for the existing hillside accommodation: home-produced goat cheese and wine, conversation about the harvest, and no extra city-dinner taxi after check-in.
proper_meal.proposed_time: 19:00 Friday, after daylight at the property.
proper_meal.published_hours: Official page: dinner daily 19:00–21:30. A booking is recommended. Friday fits; seasonal dishes and table remain unconfirmed.
proper_meal.notes: The venue's main page and menu now make the farm dinner a sound budget default. A separate paid guided tasting is unnecessary. Ask a short question about the wine already on your table; a hosted tour is not implied by dinner.

cheaper_meal.name: La Bottega della Gina XXL
cheaper_meal.why: Freshly cooked tortelloni in a simple takeaway format.
cheaper_meal.published_menu: Mixed tortelloni, eight pieces €12; selected-flavour tortelloni €12; truffle version €14. Cooked walk-and-eat service begins at 12:00, no reservation required.
cheaper_meal.basket: Two €12 tortelloni portions: €24 food. Add a €6 planning allowance for two simple drinks; takeaway avoids inventing a table-service cover charge.
cheaper_meal.hours_status: Current main menu page: Tuesday–Sunday 10:00–21:30, Monday closed, but cooked lunch still starts at 12:00. An older Gina-by-night subpage has shorter hours; use the current day menu and reconfirm evening operation if needed.
cheaper_meal.schedule_warning: This does NOT fit a pre-noon departure after San Zeno. Use it at 12:00 only if choosing an onward train around 13:00 or later, with station/luggage time. Otherwise buy a simple packed lunch at the station based on the displayed price rather than detouring across the centre.

city_dinner_alternative.name: Sottoriva 23
city_dinner_alternative.basket: Shared baccala pansfoglia €13.50 + Amarone/Monte Veronese risotto €16 + duck-ragout bigoli €16.50 + two Valpolicella glasses €5 each = €56. Add €12 planning allowance for water and two covers: target €68.
city_dinner_alternative.published_amounts: All food and wine amounts above are on the official menu; €12 water/coperto is an allowance, not a published charge.
city_dinner_alternative.hours: Official contact page has inconsistent 10:00/11:00 general opening but clearly lists the first dinner sitting 19:00–21:15. Request 19:00.
city_dinner_alternative.transport_caution: The meal can fit €80, but a return hill-to-city taxi journey costs extra. The farm dinner uses the budget better with this accommodation.

low_cost_memories.experience: Use your farm view in daylight, then share local goat cheese and the producer's Valpolicella. Ask how this year's harvest went.
low_cost_memories.cost: Included in the €63 model dinner; no extra tasting fee or tour assumed.

low_cost_memories.experience: San Zeno's medieval doors, Mantegna altarpiece and crypt on Saturday morning.
low_cost_memories.cost: Published single-church admission €4 each, €8 for two; check services.

low_cost_memories.experience: If the centre is chosen instead of the farm evening, walk Ponte Pietra and the public stairs to Castel San Pietro's viewpoint. Choose this instead of another paid tower.
low_cost_memories.cost: Self-guided public walk; no funicular ticket if walking. Allow for steps, light and energy.

downgrade_previous_recommendations.name: Al Mercante, Milan
downgrade_previous_recommendations.decision: Remove as default budget dinner; not categorically impossible for every order.
downgrade_previous_recommendations.evidence: Official menu dated 05/10/2026: cotoletta €39, cover €5/person, water €3. Two cotolette + two covers + one water = €91. Two €25 pasta dishes + shared €12 dessert + covers + water = €75, but there is little room for extras and Risoelatte gives a stronger local-food fit.

downgrade_previous_recommendations.name: La Vista, Varenna
downgrade_previous_recommendations.decision: Demote from default. Keep only if the hotel confirms an all-in order within the limit.
downgrade_previous_recommendations.evidence: Official page requires at least two courses. The linked 2025 menu lists perch €27, dessert €10 and cover €3 each: two fish mains + two desserts + covers already total €80 before water. Three-course menu €55/person exceeds the budget before drinks. A €18 pasta + €10 dessert each could instead be €62 before water, so not every order is unaffordable. These are older published prices, not a confirmed October 2026 quote.

downgrade_previous_recommendations.name: Al Pompiere, Verona
downgrade_previous_recommendations.decision: Demote as the default for this hillside stay; farm dinner is cheaper and avoids extra transfers.
downgrade_previous_recommendations.evidence: Official menu: Amarone-braised cheek €30 and tiramisu €10. Two of each total €80 before water/cover. One €24 pasta each and one shared €10 dessert could fit with a controlled allowance, but downtown dinner means extra transport. Do not describe the restaurant as impossible for all baskets.

downgrade_previous_recommendations.name: Osteria dell'Acquabella / Osteria Conchetta
downgrade_previous_recommendations.decision: Do not substitute these for Monday 19 October despite tempting published menus.
downgrade_previous_recommendations.evidence: Acquabella's own site says Mondays closed. Conchetta explicitly says both its usual location and Brioschina are closed on Monday 19 October 2026 for a private event.

optional_research_lead_not_current_price.name: Bar Il Molo, Varenna
optional_research_lead_not_current_price.evidence: Official menu page publishes general hours 08:00–24:00 daily. An older official PDF remains accessible with sandwiches €7.50–8.50 and water €2.90/0.5 L. The current menu page links an image uploaded in October 2024 that could not be visually read in this session; do not present the older PDF's numbers as verified 2026 prices.
optional_research_lead_not_current_price.practical_use: Consider for a simple snack only after reading the menu outside; use the current Victoria Grill pizza basket for a firmer price reference.
